events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with renewed hostilities between the US and Iran. This has led to a rise in oil prices and a decrease in gold prices. The conflict is expected to continue, with potential implications for global markets.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation is expected to lead to increased volatility in global markets. The rise in oil prices will likely benefit energy stocks, while the decrease in gold prices will negatively impact gold miners. The conflict may also lead to a decrease in emerging market stocks.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and gold prices for exit signals

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices drop below $60/barrel or gold prices rise above $1,500/oz
